[EN] Eliminate Remorseless Hyenas
[ES] Elimina hienas implacables
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I wonder if hyena tastes any good?
[ES] ¿Me pregunto si la hiena sabrá bien?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Fewer of them and more food for us. I like that trade.
[ES] Menos de ellas y más comida para nosotros. Me gusta ese trato.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt remorseless hyenas near the Deserted Road Camp.
[ES] Caza hienas implacables cerca del Campamento del Camino Desierto.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Glad to be of service."
[ES] Encantado de servir.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Orlaith at the Deserted Road Camp.
[ES] Informa a Orlaith en el Campamento del Camino Desierto.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
